movelist.name: Howl
movelist.effect: The user and all allies in the Burst have their Attack CS raised by 1.

movelist.name: Sand Attack
movelist.effect: The target is Blinded until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Odor Sleuth
movelist.effect: Odor Sleuth may be activated as a Swift Action on the user’s turn. For the rest of the turn, the user’s Normal-Type and Fighting-Type Moves can hit and affect Ghost-Type targets, and the user can see through the Illusion Ability, Moves with the Illusion keyword, and effects created by the Illusionist Capability, ignoring all effects from those.

abilities.name: Vital Spirit
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Sleep condition, and cannot use the move Rest. Defensive.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).
